summary: Nine NBA Cup group games were played on Friday. The Clippers scored the last seven points to beat Oklahoma City 113-112 despite 40 from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and Chicago beat Atlanta 125-117 in the night's only overtime game. San Antonio opened with an 18-0 run in a 123-85 win over Golden State, the largest margin of the night at 38 points, and Alperen Sengun's 43 points led Houston past Utah.

games.headline: Pacers hold off Knicks after late Bridges jumper
games.story: Indiana led 58-44 late in the second quarter, but New York closed the third with 10 straight points to trail only 85-84 after three. The Pacers took the lead for good at 89-87 early in the fourth and later scored 10 in a row to go up 102-89. Jalen Brunson scored 33 with 11 assists and Mikal Bridges hit a jumper with 10 seconds left to make it 106-104, but Pascal Siakam's turnover was followed by a missed Karl-Anthony Towns fadeaway at the buzzer. Siakam led Indiana with 19, Aaron Nesmith made 7 of 10 shots for 18 and Ivica Zubac had 12 points and 13 rebounds; the Pacers did not have Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Franz Wagner scores 35 as Magic beat Bucks
games.story: Orlando went ahead 4-3 in the first minutes and led the rest of the way, building a 20-point lead at 65-45 in the third quarter. Milwaukee answered with 10 straight points, but it never got closer than the final margin of eight in the second half. Franz Wagner had 35 points, nine rebounds and 12 assists, Desmond Bane made six threes for 21 points and Goga Bitadze went 5 for 5. Jaime Jaquez Jr. scored 22 for the Bucks, who shot 18 of 31 from the line; Orlando was without Paolo Banchero.

games.headline: Adebayo and Antetokounmpo score 37 each in Heat win
games.story: After 12 lead changes, Andrew Wiggins broke an 89-89 tie with a three with 34 seconds left in the third quarter, and Miami never trailed again. The Heat then scored 11 straight points early in the fourth to lead 105-93 and pushed the lead to 13. Bam Adebayo scored 37 with 14 rebounds and Giannis Antetokounmpo added 37 on 15-of-20 shooting, while Davion Mitchell had 22 points and 17 assists. Donovan Mitchell scored 25, Tyrese Proctor made five threes for 22 and James Harden had 20 for Cleveland, which did not have Evan Mobley.

games.headline: Powell scores 33 as Bulls beat Hawks in overtime
games.story: Chicago led by 18 in the second quarter, and Atlanta scored the last seven points of regulation, capped by a Jalen Johnson dunk with 1:08 left, to tie the game 110-110. Norman Powell missed two chances to win it in the final 35 seconds, then scored nine of his 33 points in overtime, where the Bulls outscored the Hawks 15-7. Josh Giddey had a triple-double with 15 points, 10 rebounds and 14 assists, and Chicago made 20 threes to Atlanta's eight. Johnson finished with 27 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists and CJ McCollum scored 20 for the Hawks.

games.headline: Grizzlies roll past Pelicans by 31
games.story: Memphis went ahead for good early in the first quarter and used a 13-0 run late in the second to lead 70-58 at halftime. New Orleans scored 10 straight to get within 80-77 in the third, but the Grizzlies closed the quarter on a 25-9 run and led by as many as 31 in the fourth. Jerami Grant scored 22 on 7-of-10 shooting off the bench, and 10 Memphis players scored in double figures while the team made 36 of 41 free throws. Saddiq Bey had 30 points and 10 rebounds and Zion Williamson added 22 for New Orleans, which did not have Dejounte Murray or Trey Murphy III; Memphis was without Zach Edey.

games.headline: Sengun scores 43 as Rockets rally past Jazz
games.story: Utah led 87-77 late in the third quarter before Houston scored 14 straight points to end the period ahead 91-87. The game had seven ties and 11 lead changes, and the Jazz got within 117-116 with 2:46 left before Houston scored eight of the last 10 points. Alperen Sengun scored 43 on 17-of-24 shooting with 12 rebounds and five assists, and Kevin Durant added 22 while going 10 for 10 on free throws. Darryn Peterson scored 28 and Keyonte George 27 for Utah, which was without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Spurs open on 18-0 run and rout Warriors
games.story: San Antonio scored the first 18 points of the game, led 38-14 after one quarter and 63-33 at halftime, and never trailed. The Spurs led by as many as 43 in the third quarter. Stephon Castle scored 32 on 12-of-18 shooting in 25 minutes, Keldon Johnson added 18 and Victor Wembanyama had 12 points, 12 rebounds and six assists. Golden State shot 31 of 93 without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III or Kristaps Porzingis, and LJ Cryer led the Warriors with 20 points on six threes.

games.headline: Avdija and Lillard lead Blazers past Kings
games.story: Portland took the lead for good late in the first quarter and led 64-53 at halftime. A 9-0 run spanning the end of the third and start of the fourth put the Trail Blazers up 98-78, and Sacramento got no closer than nine after that. Deni Avdija scored 34 on 11-of-13 shooting and 9 of 9 free throws, and Damian Lillard added 29 with six threes and 11 of 11 from the line. De'Andre Hunter scored 24 and Domantas Sabonis had 21 points and 12 rebounds for the Kings; Portland was without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe.

games.headline: Garland and-one lifts Clippers past Thunder
games.story: Los Angeles led 57-44 at halftime, but Oklahoma City scored 40 points in the third quarter to go ahead 84-82 and led 112-106 with 2:43 left. The Clippers scored the last seven points, with two Brook Lopez baskets and a Darius Garland driving layup and free throw that made it 113-112 with 50 seconds left. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, who scored 40, missed jumpers on the Thunder's last two possessions. Lopez scored 26, Garland had 24 points and seven assists, Isaiah Hartenstein made 9 of 10 shots for 21 points and 16 rebounds, and Jared McCain hit seven threes for 23; Oklahoma City did not have Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams or Cason Wallace.
